🦕 Welcome to Ride A Dino! 🌋

How to Play:
🏇 Leap onto a stampeding dinosaur and ride the canyon
💪 Train on the Dino Machines to build up your Grip
🌋 Race through 9 wild eras: Plains, Desert, Jungle, Snow, Volcano and more
🦴 Tame and collect 50+ species, from Common all the way up to Divine

✨ Hunt for Secret Dinos that only show up once in a while

🎮 Supports Desktop, Console, Mobile, and Tablet players

🧪 NEW LAB AND NEW MONSTERS ARE OUT!

Welcome to Fatal Baboons!

You're trapped in an abandoned lab, and you're not alone. Monsters roam the halls, and each one hunts in its own way. Some hear every step, some only move when you look away, and some drain the lights around them.

Collect scrap, sell it at the shop for gear, and team up with friends to survive. Stay quiet and don't get caught...

Tags: Monster, Tag, Baboon, Laboratory, Lab, Survival, Run, Escape, Horror
